First, the network auctions 100 slots each epoch, and every applicant seals a bid, so newcomers compete on price.

Then the terrace phase locks winning bids 3 epochs, while a 2-epoch challenge window lets anyone prove forgery and burn the bid; the forge keeps fake demand visible.

Finally, honest losers get refunds minus 2%. At 60 units clearing, 1,000 fakes cost 60,000, an ocean of bids doubling with demand, so bulk forgery funds its own defeat.
